scope: Projectivy horizontal transition and AuraMusic overlay alignment

assertions.overlay_recreated_per_program_change: PASS; 9 replacements, 10 focus events, no service errors
assertions.native_projectivy_row_motion_without_aur: PASS; same horizontal slide observed with AuraMusic service temporarily disabled; exact prior service list restored
assertions.no_wrong_image_crosses_card_bounds_durin: INCONCLUSIVE; screen recording shows the row sliding and poster/surface transitions, but no reliable pixel-bound assertion isolates Projectivy Surface from the AuraMusic overlay

interpretation: AuraMusic now suppresses the previous overlay as soon as Projectivy reports a different focused title and creates a fresh overlay window for the new program. Projectivy performs the same native row slide with AuraMusic's overlay service disabled. This localizes the remaining perceived motion to Projectivy's own row/preview transition; this test does not prove that its Surface never temporarily overlaps adjacent card pixels.
